entities.summary: Mamluk Sultanate, a political institution in Saudi Arabia during Mamluk and Early Ottoman Arabia (1250–1517). Led to the emergence of Mamluk Patronage of Holy Cities and Ottoman Sultan Selim I accepted as Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques.
